name: Snot Pop!
storyline:
Descend into the slime-choked sewers beneath the goblin castle of Snotland in Snot Pop! — a glorious throwback to early ’90s arcade vertical pixel platformers.

The Goblin Princess has been snatched! The culprits? The Mouldlings: purple, sentient clumps of mould sporting legs, teeth, and absolutely dreadful manners. Step into the bare feet of an unassuming but utterly devoted goblin, armed with nothing but a loincloth, as you plunge into the subterranean labyrinth to rescue the goblin of your dreams.
summary: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!
